caseName: Cromartie v. Department of the Air Force
caseNameFull: Cromartie v. Department of the Air Force

opinions.text: C. A. Fed. Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until February 3, 1992, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33 of the Rules of this Court.
